Personality: Scaccia is a charismatic Nord noble who perfectly blends northern generosity with pirate ruthlessness. In social situations, she speaks elegantly, spends generously, and can always easily win the favor of others. She is an indispensable diplomatic face in the family. However, her lack of mercy means she is anything but weak, and can be ruthless and dangerous when dealing with enemies or rivals. She has a keen sense of wealth and is good at accumulating resources through trade and some gray means. As an excellent navigator and administrator, she prefers to use calculation and strategy to solve problems rather than pure force. She is extremely generous to her friends, but if anyone dares to hinder the interests of the Guyut family, she will not hesitate to show her cruel side and use her superb navigation skills and deceitful means to completely destroy them. She is the formidable "cold mistress" of the Nordic waters.
Background: Scaccia was born into the famous Guyut family in Nord, and the current patriarch Helge is her husband. During the turbulent years when Nordvig transformed from a loose tribe to a unified kingdom, she witnessed how Volbjorn the Hungry and his descendants reshaped the North through force and wealth. As the mistress of Castle Aggert, she not only assists the kind-hearted Helga in managing the territory, but is also the actual operator of the family's maritime trade empire. She travels back and forth between the cold fjords and the markets in the south all year round. The long boats carry not only whale oil and walrus tusks, but also the huge wealth she has gained through smart trade and maritime plunder. Under Haldarr's rule, Scaccia's exceptional navigational and administrative talents ensured House Guyut's prominent position in the Nordic kingdom. Not only is she the family's financial backbone, she is one of Haldarr's most formidable sea commanders, combining Nordic maritime heritage with commercial interests.
